doorsWindows.name: Front Door
doorsWindows.safeAction: Keep closed and locked at all times
doorsWindows.notes: Primary entry point. Changes state between checks. Highest priority.

doorsWindows.name: Kitchen Window
doorsWindows.notes: Check for visual changes through glass. May crack during events.

doorsWindows.name: Living Room Window
doorsWindows.safeAction: Keep curtains drawn and window latched
doorsWindows.notes: Curtain position may change — verify both curtain and window.

doorsWindows.name: Bedroom Window
doorsWindows.notes: Can open during certain events. Check each cycle.

doorsWindows.name: Bathroom Door
doorsWindows.notes: Lower risk but still needs checking each round.

doorsWindows.name: Bedroom Door
doorsWindows.notes: Starts open. Verify state hasn't changed unexpectedly.

doorsWindows.name: Kitchen Door
doorsWindows.notes: Connects hallway to kitchen. Usually stays open.

doorsWindows.name: Balcony/Back Door
doorsWindows.notes: High-risk entry point. Lock can become disengaged between checks.
